gsp_manifest:
dependencies:
  espressif/esp_display_present:
    registry_url: https://components.espressif.com
    version: ^1.0.2
  espressif/esp_lcd_touch:
    public: true
    registry_url: https://components.espressif.com
    version: ^1
  espressif/esp_new_jpeg:
    registry_url: https://components.espressif.com
    version: 1.*
  espressif/freetype:
    registry_url: https://components.espressif.com
    version: ^2.14.2
  idf: '>=6.0'
description: Espressif Graphics Scene Processor, an ahead-of-time compiled UI framework
  for ESP-IDF.
files:
  exclude:
  - src/**/*
  - priv_include/**/*
  - components/**/*
  - artifacts/**/*
  - .gitlab-ci.yml
  - .pre-commit-config.yaml
  - .gitattributes
  - .gitignore
  - .gitmodules
  - examples/**/*
  - examples/scenarios/*/preview*.png
  - examples/scenarios/*/preview*.gif
  - examples/scenarios/*/scenes/assets/*.gif
  - examples/scenarios/*/scenes/assets/*.png
  - examples/scenarios/*/scenes/assets/*.svg
  - formats/**/*
  - config/**/*
  - ci/**/*
  - dev_docs/**/*
  - .ci-build/**/*
  - build/**/*
  - build-*/**/*
  - .pytest_cache/**/*
  - '**/.pytest_cache/**/*'
  - '**/__pycache__/**'
  - '**/*.pyc'
  - .codewhale/**/*
  - .vscode/**/*
  - tools/**/*
  - tools/sim_bridge/tests/**/*
  - skills/**/*
  - docs/_generator/**/*
  - docs/en/reference/binary-format.md
  - docs/zh-Hans/reference/binary-format.md
  - prebuilt/sim/**/*
  - adapters/headless/**/*
  - adapters/sdl/**/*
  - adapters/web/**/*
  - include/esp_gsp_sim.h
  - include/gsp/sim/**/*
  - cmake/esp_gsp_project_config_host.c.in
  - cmake/gsp_portable_targets.cmake
  include:
  - README_zh.md
  - .gspc_version
  - cmake/gsp_example_assets.cmake
  - cmake/gsp_fetch_example_assets.cmake
  - examples/README.md
  - examples/usage/hello_world/**/*
  - examples/usage/external_assets/**/*
  - examples/usage/effects/**/*
  - examples/scenarios/**/*
  - examples/common/**/*
  - examples/performance/benchmark/**/*
  - examples/usage/widgets/**/*
  - examples/usage/sim_bridge_media/**/*
  - tools/sim_bridge/build.py
  - tools/sim_bridge/run.py
  - tools/sim_bridge/rpc_client.py
  - tools/sim_bridge/protocol.h
  - tools/sim_bridge/CMakeLists.txt
  - tools/sim_bridge/README.md
  - tools/sim_bridge/src/*.c
  - tools/sim_bridge/src/*.h
  - tools/sim_bridge/include/*.h
  - tools/sim_bridge/profiles/*.yaml
issues: https://github.com/espressif/esp-gsp/issues
repository: git://github.com/espressif/esp-gsp.git
repository_info:
  commit_sha: 472207a3d4892706a16f6bafee6c6e0384645d85
  path: .
targets:
- esp32c3
- esp32s3
- esp32p4
- esp32s31
- esp32c5
- esp32c6
url: https://github.com/espressif/esp-gsp
version: 1.5.1
